name: Fuenllana (Spain)
description: White field with a crimson hoist stripe and two blue wavy stripes, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Fuenllana (a cross of Saint James and a fountain).
history: Municipal flag of Fuenllana; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Fuenllana arms — cross of Saint James and fountain
